mapper.sql: select p.procedure_id, p.student_id, p.library_cleared, p.finance_cleared, p.dormitory_cleared, p.card_returned, p.procedure_status, p.complete_date, p.status, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, s.student_no, s.student_name, c.class_name, (select count(1) from sam_procedure_item i where i.procedure_id = p.procedure_id and i.item_status = '1') as done_step_count, (select count(1) from sam_procedure_step st where st.status = '0') as total_step_count from sam_graduation_procedure p left join sam_student s on p.student_id = s.student_id left join brm_class c on s.class_id = c.class_id
mapper.insert: insert into sam_graduation_procedure (student_id, library_cleared, finance_cleared, dormitory_cleared, card_returned, procedure_status, status, create_by, create_time) select s.student_id, '0', '0', '0', '0', '0', '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() from sam_student s where s.student_status = '3' and s.student_id = #{studentId} and not exists (select 1 from sam_graduation_procedure p where p.student_id = s.student_id)
mapper.select: select count(1) as total, sum(case when procedure_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as completed, sum(case when procedure_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as inProgress, sum(case when procedure_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as notStarted from sam_graduation_procedure where status = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into sam_graduation_procedure
student_id, library_cleared, finance_cleared, dormitory_cleared, card_returned, procedure_status, complete_date, status, create_by, create_time, remark,
#{studentId}, #{libraryCleared}, #{financeCleared}, #{dormitoryCleared}, #{cardReturned}, #{procedureStatus}, #{completeDate}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark},
mapper.delete: delete from sam_graduation_procedure where procedure_id in #{procedureId}
